objective: Feature parity across every non-gold feature event; a medal requires accepted frontend behavior, not engine capability alone.

features.name: Seekbar thumbnail previews
features.acceptance: Accepted after a Windows desktop UI smoke on 2026-11-26 using a generated local AVC clip in PR #37's exact build (head 748ca7d). Pointer hover at two timeline positions displayed distinct preview frames labeled 00:01 and 00:02 while playback stayed paused at 00:03. A left click then sought to 00:02.13. The smoke verified preview positioning, pointer updates, no seek on hover, and seek on click in the actual desktop frontend. PR #23 implementation uses a separate paused libmpv client, 16 MiB bounded GPU LRU cache, coalesced requests, keyboard support and accessibility. Slint eligibility tests, real-media compositor pixel/bucket checks, and all seven exact-head hosted workflows passed. This acceptance covers Windows desktop behavior; hosted cross-platform tests cover the other builds.

features.name: Native picture in picture
features.acceptance: The base implementation is merged in PR #22: a compact always-on-top window with Play/Pause, Return and Close, preserving the prior size, position and window modes. Draft PR #36 (head ba4e45d) keeps the main player at its original size while opening PiP independently, copies and updates live frames and media state, clears stale frames for audio-only media or changed playback, forwards transport actions to the shared player callback, and keeps the View menu synchronized on Return/Close. Red/green UI tests cover the separate window lifecycle, copied/updated frames, current title/paused/status state, routed pause, hide/show, Return and menu state. All seven hosted checks passed on exact head ba4e45d: Code, Desktop UI, native helper, CodSpeed, Native controls, Windows packaging and Video compositor. Physical focus, multi-display behavior and physical multi-display presentation remain unverified; do not close this gap or claim a medal.

features.name: Gapless audio playback
features.acceptance: Implementation is in draft PR #26 at current head c5b5181. Queued playlists, automatic advancement, queue retention on Stop, native PCM capture, and hosted virtual PulseAudio loopback are implemented. All seven exact-head hosted workflows passed: Code, Desktop UI, native helper, Windows packaging, Native playback controls, Video compositor, and CodSpeed. A clean Windows worktree passed all 29 desktop UI binary tests; exact-head workspace coverage passed at 93.51% (3,835/4,101). CodSpeed reports 36 improved, 32 regressed, and 211 unchanged; 68 significant comparisons used different hardware, so this result is inconclusive. The measured UiState::confirm_loaded implementation is identical at base 2a51a80 and exact PR head c5b5181. A same-machine alternating Divan diagnostic recorded lower medians on the PR snapshot (about 3.26 ns on main versus 2.68 ns across six inputs), so there is no supported source regression to optimize and no aggregate speed claim is made. Physical multi-track listening and Previous/Next acceptance remain pending; do not close this gap or claim a medal. A draft follow-up is in PR #45 at head 51ad1f3: empty file selections retain the active queue filter, playback status, and loaded UI state. The Slint callback regression failed before the dispatcher guard and passed after it; the full desktop UI binary passed 29/29 and workspace coverage is 93.51%. All seven exact-head hosted workflows passed on PR #45 head 51ad1f3: Code checks 45901907631, Desktop UI 45901907457, Native playback controls 45901907536, native helper 45901907488, Video compositor 45901907452, Windows packaging 45901907523, and CodSpeed 45901907864. This does not change the in-progress stage; physical listening and queue-control acceptance remain pending.

features.name: DVD / Blu-ray structure playback
features.acceptance: Implementation is in draft PR #31 at ce45782: DVD/Blu-ray folder and ISO selection, structure/signature validation, disc-menu navigation, and a dispatch-path performance follow-up. All seven current-head hosted checks passed; CodSpeed reported no measured change in its comparable cases. Hosted tests exercised a generated unencrypted DVD ISO, not commercial discs. The Windows release workflow installs only the libmpv runtime; it does not package libdvdnav, libdvdread, or libbluray. VideoLAN documents libdvdnav/libdvdread as GPL-licensed and libbluray as LGPL; this records upstream licensing information, not a distribution-compliance determination. libbluray alone does not support AACS/BD+ protected commercial discs. Packaged navigation runtime, license/compliance decision, Blu-ray media, physical drives, and real-disc playback remain pending. Do not close this gap or claim a medal.

features.name: Chromecast video output
features.acceptance: Pinned transport, restricted file serving and owned playback APIs pass real TLS/HTTP fixtures. Owner-confirmed silent H.264 playback and pause/seek/resume/stop passed on two receivers during a 30-second window. The desktop Cast menu supports manual local-address entry, bounded in-app certificate inspection, explicit pin review, opt-in bounded mDNS discovery, worker controls and loaded local media with supported audio containers. Remember/forget for up to 32 explicitly reviewed local receiver pins is implemented in local user preferences. Physical desktop UI/discovery use and audio playback remain unverified; codecs beyond tested H.264 remain unverified. No casting gold is claimed.

features.name: Search and download subtitles
features.acceptance: Implementation is in draft PR #41 at head 067e957. The desktop Subtitles dialog searches OpenSubtitles by language, downloads validated SRT/ASS/SSA/WebVTT beside current local media, and adds the selection to playback. The API key stays in session memory; requests are bounded, cancellable, and HTTPS-only. Authenticated requests do not follow redirects; the API-key forwarding regression passed RED/GREEN. Closing the subtitle panel through Escape, its close button, or the outside area clears the visible key and cancels jobs; Escape is handled while either subtitle text field has focus. The exact-head desktop test explicitly focuses and edits the key field before Escape. Local optimized desktop tests passed (29/29), workspace coverage passed at 90.33%, strict Clippy and formatting passed. On 884f071, Desktop UI passed on Windows and Linux; Windows packaging, compositor, native playback controls, and CodSpeed passed; Code checks and native helper passed on Windows and Linux. All seven exact-head hosted workflows passed on 067e957, including the Windows and macOS desktop builds. The 1 MiB per-file transfer cap rejects oversized subtitle files before sidecar creation. Live provider/account behavior and visible playback against a real media file remain pending; no medal is claimed.

features.name: Touch or trackpad playback gestures
features.acceptance: The desktop video surface maps horizontal trackpad scrolling and horizontal touch drags to bounded relative seeks, and vertical scrolling/drags to volume. The software-window UI test covers 31px/32px drag thresholds, seek direction and ±15s clamps, volume 0–100 clamps, trackpad scrolling, and disabled playback state. Physical trackpad/touchscreen validation remains before acceptance; no feature medal is claimed. A Windows development-build smoke on 2026-11-26 loaded a generated H.264 clip: a 40 px horizontal drag from 0 s moved playback to 2 s; a 40 px downward drag changed volume 100→95; injected horizontal scrolling moved 2.97→1.97 s, and vertical scrolling changed volume 95→97.5. These were software mouse/scroll injections, not physical trackpad or touchscreen tests; those remain pending.

features.name: System media-control integration
features.acceptance: The shared playwire adapter connects Windows SMTC, macOS Now Playing, and Linux MPRIS. At merged PR #13 head e403070, all seven hosted checks passed, including the 90% full desktop/GPU coverage gate. Focused local Windows verification passed all 8 system-media tests and the full 31-test player-ui suite; strict UI Clippy passed with existing legacy-lint exceptions. Local default-workspace coverage was 93.64% (3,722/3,975 lines), but excludes feature-gated desktop/GPU code and is not a substitute for the hosted combined gate. On draft PR #38 head 7956695, Native playback controls run 45539812607 passed the real private-D-Bus MPRIS test: status, title/artist/album, transport capabilities, path privacy, and Play/Pause/PlayPause/Next/Previous/Seek routing were verified. CodSpeed, compositor, Windows packaging, and helper checks also passed on that head. The rustfmt-only correction is in a8c0174. All seven exact-head checks then passed: Code 45541566809, Desktop UI 45541566801, Native playback controls 45541566889, helper 45541566854, compositor 45541566786, Windows packaging 45541566795, and CodSpeed 45541566845. Physical session interaction and user-visible behavior on Windows, macOS, and Linux remain unverified; do not close the gap or claim a medal. A separate draft retry follow-up PR #43 classifies playwire Unavailable as retryable and config/unsupported errors as terminal; identical status messages are deduplicated and attempts remain one second apart. Its first hosted run found formatting-only differences; formatting corrections followed on heads 9f6a9e4 and 72e4b94; exact-head hosted workflows are still running. The corresponding Windows snapshot passed the 16-test desktop binary, strict player-UI Clippy, formatting, diff checks, and workspace coverage at 90.58% (5,722/6,317). Exact-head CI refresh for retry follow-up PR #43 (72e4b94) passed all seven workflows: Code checks 45879277020, Desktop UI 45879277037, Windows packaging 45879276988, compositor 45879277010, Native playback controls 45879276990, native helper 45879276992, and CodSpeed 45879277097. Physical OS media-session interaction remains pending; keep this gap in progress and claim no medal.

features.name: HD audio bitstream passthrough
features.acceptance: Implementation is in draft PR #27 at c1869a2: a session-only desktop control requests AC3, EAC3, DTS, DTS-HD, and TrueHD with exclusive output, and can disable passthrough. All seven current-head hosted checks passed. Exact-head CodSpeed run 45459095782 reports 3 improved and 276 unchanged benchmarks, with no measured regressions; five optimized-out and one syscall-dominated case were excluded. This replaces the earlier 13.95% aggregate improvement claim; no aggregate performance claim is made. CI does not verify bitstream output. A compatible physical receiver/route must identify each claimed format with audible output, and decoded output must still work when passthrough is disabled. Do not close this gap or claim a medal.

The full desktop player-ui suite passed locally (50 tests), and formatting/whitespace checks passed. Current CodSpeed run 45517807720 reports no measured change across 279 benchmarks; five optimized-out and two syscall-dominated cases are excluded. Windows packaging passed; Code, Desktop UI, Native controls, native helper, and compositor are queued. Physical stereoscopic display acceptance remains pending; do not close this gap or claim a medal.

features.name: Skip detected episode intros
features.acceptance: Implementation and tests are in draft PR #29 at 6a75f8b. Bounded chapter-title seeking and asynchronous IntroDB lookup validate explicit IMDb/season/episode tags, response identity, size, marker boundaries, confidence, cancellation, stale results, and seek bounds. A red/green regression now ensures a lookup finishing after playback stops cannot re-enable Skip Intro. The exact-head hosted runs all passed: Code checks (45544045194), Desktop UI (45544045300), Native playback controls (45544045294), CodSpeed (45544045280), Windows packaging (45544045367), Video compositor (45544045297), and native helper (45544045209). The live IntroDB check verified a valid no-marker response, not an available skip segment. Physical episode playback and visible Skip Intro interaction remain pending; do not close this gap or claim a medal. A local Windows UI smoke on a generated 10-second H.264 Matroska clip verified that the Playback-menu Skip Intro item enabled inside a Recap chapter at 1.57 s and sought to the next chapter boundary at 3.00 s. This confirms the chapter-title frontend path with synthetic media; real episode playback and a live IntroDB marker remain unverified, so the gap stays in progress. Follow-up draft PR #44 (latest head 1066a17) cancels in-flight IntroDB requests when a lookup is replaced, playback path or episode identity changes, or playback stops. It passes the cancellation token to the bounded HTTP subprocess and ignores cancelled callbacks. Red/green lifecycle tests include request replacement, episode change, Stop, and an unchanged snapshot. The desktop suite passes 36/36, IntroDB service tests pass 4/4 with one live-provider test intentionally ignored, and workspace coverage is 90.00%. On exact head 1066a17, Native playback controls, Windows packaging, compositor, and CodSpeed passed. Code checks, Desktop UI, and native-helper passed on Windows/Linux, with their macOS jobs still queued. Real episode playback remains pending. Keep in progress and claim no medal. Exact-head CI refresh for cancellation follow-up PR #44 (1066a17) passed all seven workflows: Code checks 45889266691, Desktop UI 45889266676, Windows packaging 45889266612, compositor 45889266630, Native playback controls 45889266646, native helper 45889266649, and CodSpeed 45889266663. Physical real-episode playback remains pending; keep this gap in progress and claim no medal.
